entries.title: Psalms 25:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 25:2
segments: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

words.text: in thee: let me not be ashamed

entries.title: Psalms 25:3
segments: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

entries.title: Psalms 25:4
segments: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

entries.title: Psalms 25:5
segments: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou [art] the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 25:6
segments: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they [have been] ever of old. {tender...: Heb. bowels}

words.text: ; for they [have been] ever of old

entries.title: Psalms 25:7
segments: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 25:8
segments: ¶Good and upright [is] the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:9
segments: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:10
segments: All the paths of the LORD [are] mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 25:11
segments: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it [is] great.

entries.title: Psalms 25:12
segments: What man [is] he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way [that] he shall choose.

entries.title: Psalms 25:13
segments: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth. {dwell...: Heb. lodge in goodness}

entries.title: Psalms 25:14
segments: The secret of the LORD [is] with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant. {and...: or, and his covenant to make them know it}

words.text: . {and...: or, and his covenant to make them know it}

entries.title: Psalms 25:15
segments: ¶Mine eyes [are] ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net. {pluck: Heb. bring forth}

entries.title: Psalms 25:16
segments: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I [am] desolate and afflicted.

words.text: thee unto me, and have mercy

entries.title: Psalms 25:17
segments: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: [O] bring thou me out of my distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 25:18
segments: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

entries.title: Psalms 25:19
segments: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred. {cruel...: Heb. hatred of violence}

entries.title: Psalms 25:20
segments: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

words.text: me: let me not be ashamed

entries.title: Psalms 25:21
segments: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

entries.title: Psalms 25:22
segments: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
